2D COLOURING & BACKGROUND INTERNSHIP - DANSKER  9 oktober 2026 Education : HBO (internships must be part of a formal school programme) Language : Dutch and/or English Location : Amsterdam - on-site or hybrid (this is not a remote internship) Hours : 32 to 40 hours Software : Toonboom (Dansker) Preferred internship periods : February - June Contact : studiotalent@submarine.nl About Submarine : Submarine's animation slate features a multitude of award-winning films and series, which are as varied in style as in their target demographic. Submarine Animation prides itself in its ability not to be confined to just one look or technique - putting the needs of each individual project front-and-center. As such, we work with 2D as well as 3D animation, digital as well as traditional crafts, and live-action/animation hybrids. About the Production: Submarine is slowly starting work on a new 2D animated feature film, developed as a co-production with JA Film (Denmark) and Doghouse Films. Our team will take on 2D animation and background production this Fall. The film is based on the graphic novel trilogy, Dansker, by Halfdan Pisket and tells the story of James, a man who flees a traumatic past in Turkey to start a new life in 1970s Denmark. Struggling with language barriers and limited opportunities, he finds himself pushed to the margins of society and drawn into a harsh criminal underworld, where survival comes at a cost. Directed by Jonas Poher Rasmussen (Academy Award-nominated for Flee), with animation direction by Liane-Cho Han (Little Amelie), the film combines frame-by-frame animation with deeply human storytelling.

Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you interested in high-tech technology? Then this could be your next step. As an Assembler at ASML, you will work on lithography machines that are used to produce microchips for the world's most advanced technologies. You will work in ASML's cleanroom factory, a unique and highly technological working environment where precision, quality, and teamwork are essential. You do not need to know everything from day one. At ASML, you learn by doing and develop your skills step by step through training, guidance, and hands-on experience. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and become part of a team that builds complex systems with the highest level of accuracy. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for someone who enjoys practical technical work and takes pride in delivering high-quality results. You are comfortable working with your hands, have an eye for detail, and understand the importance of working accurately when assembling complex systems. You enjoy working as part of a team and are willing to help colleagues when needed. At the same time, you take responsibility for your own work and are not afraid to ask questions or take initiative when you encounter a problem. You remain calm when priorities change and approach technical challenges in a practical and structured way. You are eager to learn and open to feedback. Whether you are already experienced in mechanical assembly or are looking to take the next step in your technical career, your motivation and willingness to develop are important. Education and technical experience A vocational qualification (MBO level 3 or 4) or a bachelor's degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive, Aerospace, or a comparable discipline. Hands-on experience in a technical production or service environment. Experience with mechanical assembly, testing, adjustment, and troubleshooting. Experience working with both larger mechanical components afine mechanical parts. Ability to read and understand technical drawings and work instructions. Good command of English, both written and spoken, for daily communication and documentation. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will work in a unique high-tech environment where you can develop your technical skills and contribute to technology that is used all over the world. You will receive extensive training and guidance and have the opportunity to build a long-term career within an international organization. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €3,771, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance. An additional 0.65% ADV allowance. A 13th-month salary. An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines play a crucial role in the production of microchips, which are used in virtually all modern technologies. As an Assembler, you are an essential part of this process. Your craftsmanship, precision, and attention to detail ensure that complex components and systems are assembled correctly and meet ASML's high quality standards. Every component you assemble contributes to a larger system, and every system contributes to the technology that enables the next generation of microchips. Your hands. Your craftsmanship. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow. Functieomschrijving After completing a solid training program at the ASML Academy, you will be ready to start working independently within the production environment. As an Assembler, you will build complex systems step by step, following clear work instructions and technical drawings.
